text: 交通运输部、国家发展改革委、财政部、人力资源社会保障部发布《关于促进城市公交企业深化改革的指导意见》，其中提出，严格落实政府补贴补偿制度。贯彻落实《城市公共交通条例》相关规定，落实市县级财政支出责任，根据城市公共交通实际和财政承受能力安排城市公共交通发展所需经费并纳入本级预算。城市人民政府要在公交企业营收达不到年度预期目标时，按规定做好政策支持，采取措施保障公交线路正常运行。
text_en: The Ministry of Transport, the National Development and Reform Commission, the Ministry of Finance, and the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security issued the Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Deepening Reform of Urban Public Transport Enterprises, which proposes strictly implementing the government subsidy and compensation system. The relevant provisions of the Regulations on Urban Public Transport shall be implemented, municipal and county-level fiscal expenditure responsibilities shall be fulfilled, and funds needed for urban public transport development shall be arranged according to the actual situation of urban public transport and fiscal affordability and included in the corresponding level's budget. When the revenue of public transport enterprises falls short of the annual expected target, urban people's governments shall provide policy support in accordance with regulations and take measures to ensure the normal operation of public transport routes.
